milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the spruce door (at spawn-relative x=5, y=1, z=4) and face toward it. max_distance=5 ensures the player has moved from spawn (spawn-to-door distance is ~6.4 blocks, so player must walk at least ~1.4 blocks closer) and is close enough to clearly identify it as a spruce door. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at the door.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The sugar cane is inside the enclosed greenhouse at spawn-relative x=5, y=1, z=7. max_distance reduced to 3 (per Validator recommendation) to prevent the milestone from being satisfied from outside the building's opaque spruce plank walls — the back wall exterior at z=10 would be ~3.2 blocks away which is marginal, and combined with facing_tolerance=60 requiring the player to face toward the target through a solid wall, this effectively forces the player to be inside the building. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the sugar cane.
